changelog: Single proven libVLC player engine (libvlc-all:3.6.2) for all channels
Instant channel switching with locked 1500ms network caching
4-stage failover: Direct -> Backup -> In-app local proxy
Hardware acceleration with edge-to-edge fullscreen fill
Smart route memory and instant resume on last played channel
